stage: Synthetic-scenario prototype of the Eq. (20) optimization layer; no generative model

configuration.scenario_seed_derivation: SHA256(root seed, UTC decision time, model tag, scenario index), first 128 bits
configuration.horizon_rule: Next declared rebalance capped by relevant expiry; strictly after execution eligibility
configuration.gross_scale: Initial sum of absolute marked fixed target legs, captured at the first policy callback

definitions.gross_hedge_error_currency: -(liability P&L + hedge P&L); actual gross tracking residual, excluding trading/financing costs
definitions.hedge_instruments_used: Number of distinct instruments with accepted hedge fills, including exits
definitions.turnover: Currency traded on both sides; stock and option-premium amounts reported separately
definitions.scenario_residual_mse: In-sample conditional fit diagnostic, not observed or out-of-sample hedge performance

metadata.source: synthetic correlated GBM fixture v1; not historical market data
metadata.purpose: mechanics only, no calibration or profitability claim
metadata.calendar: twenty toy business days by default; weekdays only, no holiday calendar
metadata.scenario_timing: Next scheduled business-day close, declared in the current event; no future prices
metadata.funding: declared toy cash 1%, collateral 0.5%, stock borrow 2%; no proceeds rebate

provenance.hash_timing: File hashes are computed after the run for provenance; the engine never receives them.

interpretation: One synthetic path; no distributional or profitability claim. Compare different stopping times only at matched valid checkpoints.
